name: Lymphogranuloma venereum
advice: Complete the full 3-week course; avoid sex until treatment is finished and partners (last 60 days) are treated. Tests: HIV, VDRL/TPHA, HBsAg; NAAT for chlamydia if available. Fluctuant buboes are aspirated through normal skin — do not incise. Doxycycline is not used in pregnancy.
